entries.summaryZh: 1121年8月，格鲁吉亚国王大卫四世在第比利斯以西的迪德格里迎战伊尔加齐率领的塞尔柱军队。格鲁吉亚军以地形限制对方机动，先以少量部队诱敌深入，再用主力夹击，取得决定性胜利。战后格鲁吉亚收复第比利斯并将其恢复为首都，开启所谓黄金时代。
entries.summaryEn: In August 1121 King David IV of Georgia met the Seljuk army of Ilghazi at Didgori, west of Tbilisi. The Georgians used the narrow ground to limit enemy manoeuvre, drew the Seljuks in with a small force and then struck with their main body. The victory let Georgia retake Tbilisi and restore it as the capital.
entries.significanceZh: 迪德格里之战结束了塞尔柱对格鲁吉亚的宗主权，被视为格鲁吉亚黄金时代的开端。
entries.significanceEn: Didgori ended Seljuk overlordship over Georgia and is treated as the beginning of the Georgian Golden Age.
entries.notesZh: 英文维基与多数英文著述记为8月12日，中文维基记为8月21日；本条只保留1121年的年份精度。
entries.notesEn: English Wikipedia and most accounts give 12 August, Chinese Wikipedia gives 21 August; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1898年9月2日，基奇纳统率的英埃远征军在苏丹恩图曼以北的凯雷里击败马赫迪国军队，哈里发阿卜杜拉希的部队在马克沁机枪与炮火下损失惨重。英埃军队随后占领恩图曼，马赫迪国崩溃，英国与埃及得以重新控制苏丹，英军阵亡不足五十人。
entries.summaryEn: On 2 September 1898 a British and Egyptian expeditionary force under Kitchener defeated the army of the Mahdist state at Kerreri, north of Omdurman in Sudan. The Khalifa Abdallahi's troops suffered heavily under Maxim guns and artillery, and the fall of Omdurman ended Mahdist power and returned Sudan to Anglo-Egyptian control.
entries.significanceZh: 恩图曼之战终结了马赫迪国，也展示了机枪时代对传统冲击战术的压倒性优势。
entries.significanceEn: Omdurman destroyed the Mahdist state and showed the overwhelming effect of machine guns on massed charges.
entries.notesZh: 马赫迪军阵亡数字（约一万至三万）出自不同来源，差异较大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Mahdist casualty estimates range from about 10,000 to 30,000 depending on the source; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1560年6月，东海道大名今川义元率大军进入尾张国，织田信长在暴雨中率少数亲兵突袭今川军本阵，今川义元阵亡。战后今川氏迅速衰落，织田信长转而扩张势力，逐步控制京都周边，为其日后主导日本政局奠定基础，此战也成为战国史上以寡击众的著名战例。
entries.summaryEn: In June 1560 the Imagawa warlord Yoshimoto marched into Owari province with a far larger army. Oda Nobunaga attacked his headquarters in a rainstorm with a small force and killed him. The Imagawa clan declined rapidly while Nobunaga expanded towards Kyoto, laying the base for his later dominance of central Japan.
entries.significanceZh: 桶狭间之战是日本战国以寡击众的著名战例，也是织田信长崛起的起点。
entries.significanceEn: Okehazama is the classic case of a smaller force defeating a larger one in the Sengoku period and the starting point of Nobunaga's rise.
entries.notesZh: 交战日按公历记为6月12日，按旧历记为永禄三年五月十九日，今川军兵力估算从两万五千到四万五千不等；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The date is 12 June in the Gregorian calendar and the nineteenth day of the fifth month in the lunar calendar, and Imagawa's army is estimated at 25,000 to 45,000; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元251年夏，罗马皇帝德西乌斯率军在默西亚的阿伯里图斯（今保加利亚拉兹格勒）附近与哥特国王尼瓦的联军交战。罗马军被诱入沼泽地带后遭到围歼，德西乌斯与其子赫伦尼乌斯双双阵亡，德西乌斯成为首位在与外敌作战中阵亡的罗马皇帝。
entries.summaryEn: In the summer of 251 the Roman emperor Decius fought a Gothic and Scythian coalition under King Cniva near Abritus, modern Razgrad in Bulgaria. The Romans were drawn into marshy ground and destroyed, and Decius and his son Herennius Etruscus were both killed. Decius was the first emperor to die fighting a foreign enemy.
entries.significanceZh: 阿伯里图斯是罗马帝国对哥特人最惨重的败仗之一，也是三世纪危机中皇权动荡的标志性事件。
entries.significanceEn: Abritus was one of Rome's worst defeats at Gothic hands and a landmark of imperial instability during the third-century crisis.
entries.notesZh: 战役的具体日期、地点与双方兵力在史料中均有争议，阿伯里图斯只是最常被接受的战场；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The exact date, site and army sizes are all debated, with Abritus merely the most widely accepted location; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元533年9月13日，贝利撒留率东罗马远征军在迦太基附近的阿德底斯姆击败汪达尔国王格列摩尔。汪达尔军在分进合击中指挥失序，格列摩尔见其弟阵亡后脱离战场，贝利撒留趁势夺取迦太基。汪达尔王国由此迅速瓦解，北非重回罗马治下。
entries.summaryEn: On 13 September 533 a Byzantine expedition under Belisarius defeated the Vandal king Gelimer at Ad Decimum near Carthage. The Vandal counter-attack lost coordination and Gelimer left the field after his brother was killed, allowing Belisarius to take Carthage. The Vandal kingdom collapsed and North Africa returned to Roman rule.
entries.significanceZh: 阿德底斯姆之战是查士丁尼西部再征服的第一场决战，汪达尔王国的覆亡由此开始。
entries.significanceEn: Ad Decimum was the first decisive battle of Justinian's reconquest in the west and began the collapse of the Vandal kingdom.
entries.notesZh: 交战地点阿德底斯姆（意为第十里程碑）的确切位置与汪达尔军兵力仍有争议；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The exact site of Ad Decimum, the tenth milestone, and the size of the Vandal army remain disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1920年7月24日，法国黎凡特军队在反黎巴嫩山脉的麦塞隆山口击败阿拉伯叙利亚王国的军队，战斗仅数小时。叙方指挥官优素福·阿兹马战死，法军随后占领大马士革，费萨尔一世被逐。这次失败终结了阿拉伯人自起义以来建立的独立政权。
entries.summaryEn: On 24 July 1920 French forces of the Army of the Levant defeated the army of the Arab Kingdom of Syria at the Maysalun pass in the Anti-Lebanon mountains in a battle lasting only hours. The Syrian commander Yusuf al-Azma was killed, the French occupied Damascus and Faisal I was expelled, ending the short-lived Arab kingdom.
entries.significanceZh: 麦塞隆之战终结了阿拉伯叙利亚王国，也确立了法国对叙利亚与黎巴嫩的委任统治。
entries.significanceEn: Maysalun ended the Arab Kingdom of Syria and confirmed the French mandate over Syria and Lebanon.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力数字（叙方数千、法方数万）出自不同记述，战斗时长一般记为四小时；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Accounts differ on the size of both forces and the fighting is generally given as four hours; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年4月1日至18日，美军第1集团军与第9集团军在德国鲁尔区完成合围，围歼莫德尔元帅的B集团军群。被围德军约三十二万人投降，含二十余名将军，莫德尔在投降前自杀。此役使西线德军主力瓦解，盟军得以向东推进至易北河，被围德军大部被俘。
entries.summaryEn: From 1 to 18 April 1945 the US First and Ninth Armies closed a pocket around Army Group B in the Ruhr and destroyed it. About 317,000 German troops, including more than twenty generals, surrendered; Field Marshal Model killed himself rather than surrender. The battle broke the main German force in the west.
entries.significanceZh: 鲁尔包围战是西线最大规模的围歼战，此后德军再无力组织成建制的西线防御。
entries.significanceEn: The Ruhr pocket was the largest encirclement in the west and left Germany unable to mount an organised defence there.
entries.notesZh: 被俘人数各来源在三十万至三十二万五千之间，本条采用三十二万的约数；只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Prisoner figures range from 300,000 to 325,000 across sources and this entry uses the approximate 317,000; it keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 2017年5月23日，毛特组织与阿布沙耶夫武装在菲律宾棉兰老岛马拉维市发动攻击并升起伊斯兰国旗帜，政府军随即反攻。巷战持续五个月，城市大部被毁，数十万人流离失所，武装头目哈皮隆与奥马尔·毛特先后被击毙，10月23日政府宣布战斗结束。
entries.summaryEn: On 23 May 2017 Maute and Abu Sayyaf militants seized parts of Marawi on Mindanao in the Philippines and raised Islamic State flags, and government forces counter-attacked. The urban fighting lasted five months and destroyed much of the city; leaders Isnilon Hapilon and Omar Maute were killed and the battle was declared over on 23 October.
entries.significanceZh: 马拉维危机是伊斯兰国在东南亚最具规模的攻势，也是菲律宾现代史上最长的城市战。
entries.significanceEn: Marawi was Islamic State's largest offensive in Southeast Asia and the longest urban battle in modern Philippine history.
entries.notesZh: 各方公布的武装分子与平民死亡数字差异很大，且被困平民的伤亡仍无定论；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Official casualty figures for militants and civilians differ widely and civilian deaths remain unsettled; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元740年，倭马亚王朝分三路入侵拜占庭小亚细亚，其中两万人在阿卜杜拉·巴塔尔率领下于弗里吉亚的阿克洛伊农（今阿菲永附近）被利奥三世与其子君士坦丁五世击败，巴塔尔阵亡。此役后倭马亚对安纳托利亚的大规模攻势基本停止，拜占庭转入反攻。
entries.summaryEn: In 740 an Umayyad invasion of Byzantine Asia Minor in three columns was met at Akroinon in Phrygia, near modern Afyon. The column of about 20,000 under Abdallah al-Battal was defeated by Leo III and his son Constantine V, and al-Battal was killed. Large-scale Umayyad offensives into Anatolia largely ended thereafter.
entries.significanceZh: 阿克洛伊农是拜占庭由守转攻的转折点，此后倭马亚再未能对安纳托利亚发动同等规模的进攻。
entries.significanceEn: Akroinon marked Byzantium's turn from defence to counter-attack and ended comparable Umayyad offensives into Anatolia.
entries.notesZh: 阿拉伯一方兵力两万出自拜占庭与阿拉伯史料的常见记载，具体日期与战场位置仍有争议；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The figure of 20,000 comes from the usual Byzantine and Arab accounts, while the exact date and site remain disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1513年9月9日，苏格兰国王詹姆斯四世为履行与法国的同盟，率军越过边境进入英格兰北部，在诺森伯兰的弗洛登原野与萨里伯爵的英军交战。苏格兰军以长矛方阵进攻不利地形，被英军长弓与火炮击溃，詹姆斯四世与大批贵族阵亡，苏格兰此后长期无力再发动大规模入侵。
entries.summaryEn: On 9 September 1513 James IV of Scotland invaded northern England to honour his alliance with France and met the Earl of Surrey's army at Flodden Field in Northumberland. Scottish pike formations attacked over difficult ground and were broken by English archery and artillery; James IV and much of the Scottish nobility were killed.
entries.significanceZh: 弗洛登是英格兰与苏格兰之间规模最大的会战，苏格兰精锐与贵族阶层在此战中损失殆尽。
entries.significanceEn: Flodden was the largest battle ever fought between England and Scotland and destroyed much of the Scottish military elite.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力（苏格兰约三万、英格兰约两万六千）为现代估算，史料数字更大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Modern estimates of about 30,000 Scots and 26,000 English are lower than the figures in contemporary accounts; this entry keeps year precision.
